Function CellValue(c As Range) As String

CellValue="Error:" & c.Text
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
CellValue="Empty"
Else
CellValue=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As Range,n As Name,s As String,r As Long
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
s="filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";auto=" & CStr(ws.AutoFilterMode) & ";hidden="
For r=1 To 14
If ws.Rows(r).Hidden Then s=s & CStr(r) & ","
Next
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];output=["
For Each c In ws.Range("F1:I12").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];source=["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:D9").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,v As Variant,before As String,after As String,n As Long,s As String

ws.Name="Data"

Function CellValue(c As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
v=c.Value2
If IsError(v) Then
CellValue="Error:" & c.Text
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
CellValue="Empty"
Else
CellValue=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As Range,n As Name,s As String,r As Long
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
s="filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";auto=" & CStr(ws.AutoFilterMode) & ";hidden="
For r=1 To 14
If ws.Rows(r).Hidden Then s=s & CStr(r) & ","
Next
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];output=["
For Each c In ws.Range("F1:I12").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];source=["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:D9").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function

Function CellValue(c As Range) As String

v=c.Value2

CellValue="Error:" & c.Text
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
CellValue="Empty"
Else
CellValue=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As Range,n As Name,s As String,r As Long
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
s="filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";auto=" & CStr(ws.AutoFilterMode) & ";hidden="
For r=1 To 14
If ws.Rows(r).Hidden Then s=s & CStr(r) & ","
Next
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];output=["
For Each c In ws.Range("F1:I12").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];source=["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:D9").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function

Dim ws As Worksheet,v As Variant,before As String,after As String,n As Long,s As String

probes.name: inplace-existing-hidden
probes.source:
Function CellValue(c As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
v=c.Value2
If IsError(v) Then
CellValue="Error:" & c.Text
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
CellValue="Empty"
Else
CellValue=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As Range,n As Name,s As String,r As Long
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
s="filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";auto=" & CStr(ws.AutoFilterMode) & ";hidden="
For r=1 To 14
If ws.Rows(r).Hidden Then s=s & CStr(r) & ","
Next
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];output=["
For Each c In ws.Range("F1:I12").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];source=["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:D9").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,v As Variant,before As String,after As String,n As Long,s As String
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:D1").Value=Array("Name","Qty","Tag","Calc")
ws.Range("A2:D2").Value=Array("apple",1,"x",10)
ws.Range("A3:D3").Value=Array("Apple",2,"x",20)
ws.Range("A4:D4").Value=Array("apricot",2,"y",20)
ws.Range("A5:D5").Value=Array("banana",3,"x",30)
ws.Range("A6:D6").Value=Array("banana",3,"y",30)
ws.Range("A7:D7").Value=Array("applepie",4,"x",40)
ws.Range("A8:D8").Value=Array("apple",1,"x",10)
ws.Range("A9:D9").Value=Array("pear",5,"",50)
ws.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=18
ws.Range("F1:I1").Value=Array("Name","Qty","Tag","Calc")
ws.Range("F2:I12").Value="old"
ws.Range("J1").Value="Name"
ws.Range("J2").Value="apple"
ws.Rows(2).Hidden=True
ws.Rows(13).Hidden=True
before=Snapshot()
On Error GoTo Failed
v=ws.Range("A1:D9").AdvancedFilter(1,ws.Range("J1:J2"))
after=Snapshot()

Probe="return=" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v) & ";before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];follow=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];after=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

probes.name: extract-gapped-old-content
probes.source:
Function CellValue(c As Range) As String
Dim v As Variant
v=c.Value2
If IsError(v) Then
CellValue="Error:" & c.Text
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
CellValue="Empty"
Else
CellValue=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End If
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c As Range,n As Name,s As String,r As Long
Set ws=Worksheets("Data")
s="filter=" & CStr(ws.FilterMode) & ";auto=" & CStr(ws.AutoFilterMode) & ";hidden="
For r=1 To 14
If ws.Rows(r).Hidden Then s=s & CStr(r) & ","
Next
s=s & ";names=["
For Each n In ActiveWorkbook.Names
s=s & n.Name & ":" & n.RefersTo & ":" & CStr(n.Visible) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];output=["
For Each c In ws.Range("F1:I12").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & ":nf=" & CStr(c.NumberFormat) & ":b=" & CStr(c.Font.Bold) & ":fill=" & CStr(c.Interior.Color) & "|"
Next
s=s & "];source=["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:D9").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CellValue(c) & ":f=" & CStr(c.Formula) & "|"
Next
Snapshot=s & "]"
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,v As Variant,before As String,after As String,n As Long,s As String
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:D1").Value=Array("Name","Qty","Tag","Calc")
ws.Range("A2:D2").Value=Array("apple",1,"x",10)
ws.Range("A3:D3").Value=Array("Apple",2,"x",20)
ws.Range("A4:D4").Value=Array("apricot",2,"y",20)
ws.Range("A5:D5").Value=Array("banana",3,"x",30)
ws.Range("A6:D6").Value=Array("banana",3,"y",30)
ws.Range("A7:D7").Value=Array("applepie",4,"x",40)
ws.Range("A8:D8").Value=Array("apple",1,"x",10)
ws.Range("A9:D9").Value=Array("pear",5,"",50)
ws.Range("A:L").ColumnWidth=18
ws.Range("F1:I1").Value=Array("Name","Qty","Tag","Calc")
ws.Range("F2:I12").Value="old"
ws.Range("J1").Value="Name"
ws.Range("J2").Value="apple"
ws.Range("F2:I12").ClearContents
ws.Range("F3:I3").Value="first"
ws.Range("F10:I10").Value="far"
before=Snapshot()
On Error GoTo Failed
v=ws.Range("A1:D9").AdvancedFilter(2,ws.Range("J1:J2"),ws.Range("F1:I1"))
after=Snapshot()

Probe="return=" & TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v) & ";before=[" & before & "];after=[" & after & "];follow=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ";before=[" & before & "];after=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function

Function TryAF(k As Long) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant
v=Worksheets("Data").Range("A1:D9").AdvancedFilter(k,Worksheets("Data").Range("J1:J2"),Worksheets("Data").Range("F1:I1"))
TryAF=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
TryAF="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
